target.statement: QAaP achieves 60.3 EM on TempQuestions (explicit subset) with gpt-3.5-turbo, vs 49.8 for CoT

compute.basis: The method is a few-shot LLM pipeline (no training), but reproducing the 60.3 EM cell requires ~297 questions x multiple gpt-3.5-turbo calls (parse, generate background, extract per context, check, match) plus a Wikipedia search step; API cost/latency and the closed gpt-3.5-turbo backbone dominate, and the repo may not include the exact prompts/configs.

blockers: Requires OpenAI gpt-3.5-turbo API (closed model, paid, non-deterministic)
Reproduction depends on live Wikipedia search results which change over time
Exact prompt/configs may be missing or outdated in the repo
title: Question Answering as Programming for Solving Time-Sensitive Questions
